runners_data.name: Fenlander
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with clear tactical advantage in a race lacking early pace, though 135 days off and inconsistent form are concerns

runners_data.name: Good Earth
runners_data.note: Strong recent winner but hold-up style faces traffic problems with seven others employing similar tactics

runners_data.name: Daytona Lady
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning after 162 days with headgear changes suggesting connections seeking improvement

runners_data.name: Neyva's Angel
runners_data.note: Another hold-up runner in a crowded field of back-markers, headgear applied but form has declined

runners_data.name: Tuscan Point
runners_data.note: Recent winner in good form but hold-up style puts him in traffic with the majority of the field

runners_data.name: Beelzebub
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner carrying bottom weight but headgear suggests trainer concerns about attitude

runners_data.name: Andalprofit
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with solid recent form but faces the same positioning problems as similar runners

runners_data.name: Starsong
runners_data.note: Prominent runner like Fenlander who should avoid the traffic problems facing the hold-up horses

runners_data.name: Melissa Honey
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 149 days break among the weakest on ratings

races.paceDynamic: Fenlander and Starsong are the only pace-pressing types in a field dominated by hold-up horses, creating a tactical scenario where early tempo will be modest rather than fierce. With seven confirmed hold-up runners including Good Earth, Daytona Lady, Tuscan Point and Andalprofit all needing to come from off the pace, the early gallop will be controlled but the final 2f will see a wall of horses trying to make their moves simultaneously. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can position closer to the pace early and avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the back-markers in the home straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Fenlander and Starsong dictate a steady tempo without pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows prominent runners to travel sweetly before the hold-up brigade can organize their challenge. Fenlander gets first run while the back-markers encounter traffic problems in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up contingent gets badly hampered in running
scenarios.body: Seven horses trying to come from the back creates a cavalry charge where only the luckiest or widest-drawn escape trouble. The race becomes a lottery decided by who finds the clearest passage rather than pure ability.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Two Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Fenlander and Starsong set unsustainable fractions or tie up
scenarios.body: The early leaders come back to the field dramatically in the final furlong allowing the best of the closers to sweep past. This requires the pace-setters to go too fast early which seems unlikely given the lack of pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses find room simultaneously creating a blanket finish
scenarios.body: The modest early pace keeps everyone in contention turning for home leading to a desperate scramble where any of six horses could prevail. The winner emerges from pure luck rather than tactical positioning.

watchPoints.text: Fenlander and Starsong must be watched for early pace as they hold all the tactical cards with seven hold-up horses behind them
Good Earth despite recent win faces severe traffic problems with six other hold-up runners creating a bottleneck
Daytona Lady and Melissa Honey both returning from long breaks exceeding 140 days may need the run
The draw becomes crucial for hold-up runners as inside berths could prove fatal in the home straight scramble
Tuscan Point carries a 6lb penalty for recent win which may prove decisive in a tight handicap finish

runners_data.name: Colori Forever
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 162 days off with Marco Ghiani taking the ride, suggesting connections expect a competitive showing despite the layoff

runners_data.name: Just A Girl
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with poor recent form but proven at this 7f trip, likely to set a strong pace with Loblolly

runners_data.name: Loblolly
runners_data.note: Leading pace-setter with solid standard going record (1W3P from 6 runs) and apprentice Jack Callan's 5lb claim provides a significant weight advantage

runners_data.name: French Affair
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in excellent recent form with a win just 18 days ago, ideally positioned to track the pace under in-form Hannon stable

runners_data.name: Henry Halflight
runners_data.note: Course specialist with perfect 3-from-3 record on standard going, dropping in grade after recent Lingfield success

runners_data.name: Come On Eibhlin
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 163 days with a warning that she fades in the finish, making her vulnerable late on

runners_data.name: Wetsand
runners_data.note: Reliable prominent performer carrying top weight of 135lbs after mixed recent efforts, needs to bounce back to form

runners_data.name: Gold Queen Kindly
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with disappointing recent efforts, needs a strong pace collapse to be competitive from her usual rearward position

races.paceDynamic: Just A Girl and Loblolly will dispute the early lead in this 7f handicap, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a solid gallop from the off. The prominent runners French Affair, Henry Halflight, Wetsand and Come On Eibhlin will track close behind this pace, while the two hold-up horses Colori Forever and Gold Queen Kindly will need the leaders to maintain their effort. With genuine pace guaranteed and a straight 7f at Southwell providing limited opportunities for late swoops, this race strongly favours prominent racers who can sit close to the pace and kick when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders Just A Girl and Loblolly burn each other out with their early battle
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will set up perfectly for the quartet of prominent runners to pounce in the final two furlongs. French Affair's recent form and Henry Halflight's course record make them prime beneficiaries of this likely scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If either Just A Girl or Loblolly can establish a clear advantage without burning excessive energy
scenarios.body: The winner can dictate terms and have enough left to repel late challenges on Southwell's testing straight. Loblolly's superior recent form and fitness edge from his standard going record gives him the better chance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse charges late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes exceptionally strong with multiple horses going too fast too early
scenarios.body: The collapse of the pace-setters and prominent runners opens the door for the back markers to sweep up. Colori Forever's higher class rating and Ghiani's booking suggests connections expect this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders and prominent runners completely capitulate after unsustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f marker heavily favouring those with the most energy reserves. This unlikely scenario would create chaos and open the door for any runner with a turn of foot.

watchPoints.text: Just A Girl and Loblolly must be monitored early - if they go too fast the race could completely fall apart
Come On Eibhlin has a history of fading late so watch for her position turning into the straight
Henry Halflight's perfect standard going record makes any drift in the betting significant
Colori Forever's 162-day absence means her fitness levels are uncertain despite Ghiani's presence
French Affair's trainer Richard Hannon runs at 5/30 in the last 14 days, suggesting this runner is expected to perform

runners_data.name: Selection
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with solid recent course form but carrying top weight and trainer struggling for winners

runners_data.name: Song N Dance
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 155-day break with winning course form but faces fitness questions

runners_data.name: Pendella
runners_data.note: Prominent type with recent winning form and effective trainer but steps up in class from maiden success

runners_data.name: Likeness
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner with consistent place record but yet to win and facing stronger opposition

runners_data.name: Kiss Me My Love
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with poor recent form and trainer completely out of form, wrong style for likely pace scenario

races.paceDynamic: City Queen will lead with no natural pace pressure in this small field of six fillies. Selection, Song N Dance, Pendella and Likeness all have prominent tendencies but lack the natural speed to challenge City Queen early, allowing her to dictate fractions. The race will develop into a tactical affair with the prominent runners tracking behind before a sustained drive from the 2f pole. This setup strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace, as Kiss Me My Love's hold-up style will struggle against the likely modest gallop and compressed finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If City Queen gets her own way in front with comfortable splits
scenarios.body: City Queen controls the tempo completely and has enough left to repel late challenges. Her proven course form and lack of early pressure creates the ideal scenario for Charlie Appleby's filly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners positions perfectly behind City Queen
scenarios.body: The pace allows the best-positioned prominent runner to strike with a well-timed challenge in the final furlong. Song N Dance's return from a break could provide the freshness needed to capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The tactical nature backfires as faster finishers get their chance in a bunched finish. Pendella's recent form and Burke's good strike rate could benefit from such circumstances.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If Kiss Me My Love finds significant improvement from the back
scenarios.body: The outsider benefits from a truly-run race and improved form bounce. Her hold-up style only works if genuine pace materializes, which seems unlikely given the field composition.

watchPoints.text: City Queen's jumping - if she breaks slowly or misses the break, it completely changes the pace dynamic with no obvious replacement leader
Song N Dance's fitness after 155 days off - any signs of rustiness early could compromise her chances despite the tactical advantage
Selection's weight burden at 139lbs - watch if Jack Hart can get her positioned without using up energy fighting the handicap
Kiss Me My Love's early positioning - if she's closer than usual it might indicate connections expect a stronger pace
Pendella's class step-up - monitor if the step from maiden to handicap company affects her confidence early in the race

races.paceDynamic: Union Island and Looks Fantastic are the only prominent racers, with Union Island showing more consistent front-running tendencies and likely to dictate from the start. With six hold-up horses behind them, this creates a tactical scenario where the early leaders face minimal pressure through the first half-mile. The pace will be controlled rather than fierce, allowing Union Island to string the field out without burning energy. This moderate tempo strongly favours horses that can travel kindly in behind and produce a sustained finish, giving the hold-up brigade a clear tactical advantage over the lone front-runner.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Union Island sets uncontested fractions and the hold-up horses get the perfect tow
scenarios.body: The controlled pace allows the back-markers to conserve energy and unleash finishing kicks in the final two furlongs. Marry The Night and Dream Illusion, both in excellent recent form, benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Union Island gets easy lead and kicks clear when the hold-up horses are still organizing
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Union Island to control the race completely and maintain enough energy for a decisive move. The hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up despite the favorable pace scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Looks Fantastic or a hold-up horse moves earlier than expected to apply pressure
scenarios.body: This forces Union Island to respond and quickens the overall tempo, creating a more genuinely-run race. The horses with the best tactical speed and recent form benefit from the increased pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Union Island sets very slow fractions and no one challenges until very late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish from the final furlong with the entire field converging. The freshest horses and those with the best turn of foot in small fields get the advantage.

watchPoints.text: Union Island must be watched for signs of ring-rustiness after 40 days off when asked to control the early pace
Dream Illusion carries a 3lb claiming jockey which could prove decisive in a tight finish between hold-up horses
Marry The Night's recent excellent form suggests peak fitness but Tim Easterby's 0/12 record adds concern
Looks Fantastic's 107-day layoff makes stamina reserves questionable if required to pressure Union Island early
The lack of natural pace-pressers means watching for any horse that breaks the expected tactical pattern

races.paceDynamic: The Lakes will lead uncontested from the start, setting a moderate gallop with all other runners adopting hold-up tactics behind. This creates a false pace scenario where The Lakes can dictate terms without pressure, potentially setting up a dawdling tempo throughout the middle sections. With eight hold-up horses bunched behind the lone leader, the race will develop into a sprint finish from the home turn. This tactical setup strongly favours the highest-rated hold-up horses who can quicken best from off the pace, particularly those with proven finishing kicks like Poppeye and Desert Belle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Quality Prevails Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The highest-rated horses with proven class will have too much quality for the field when it matters. Poppeye's OR 120 and Desert Belle's consistent form give them decisive advantages in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Upset From Mid-Pack
scenarios.trigger: If The Lakes sets genuine fractions and tires the favourites
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out the top-rated horses, allowing consistent performers like John Galt to capitalize. His recent Southwell form and understanding of the track conditions give him the edge over fading favourites.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: The Lakes Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If The Lakes gets easy sectionals and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: With no early pressure, The Lakes can save energy for a sustained drive to the line despite his low rating. The field's reluctance to go forward early hands him an unassailable advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If pace collapse creates chaos and the race falls apart completely
scenarios.body: In a messy finish where positioning trumps ability, an outsider like Havana's Tune can steal it with a well-timed run. The tactical muddle negates class differences and rewards the best-positioned runner.

watchPoints.text: The Lakes getting too soft a lead early - if uncontested through half-mile he becomes very dangerous despite low rating
Poppeye's positioning from the gates - with unknown running style, where Stammers places him will determine his chances completely
Desert Belle's finishing kick - if she gets the expected strong pace to aim at, her class edge should tell decisively
John Galt's tactical position - Saffie Osborne needs to avoid getting boxed in the expected bunched field turning for home
Pure Moon's fitness levels after 164-day absence - any market move would suggest Clover has him ready despite the layoff

races.paceDynamic: Lednikov will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting what should be a comfortable tempo with no early pressure from the nine hold-up horses behind him. With virtually the entire field content to settle off the pace, Lednikov can dictate terms through moderate fractions, creating a tactical affair where positioning and timing become crucial. This even gallop will set up perfectly for horses with a strong finishing kick who can produce their best work late. The overwhelming prevalence of hold-up runners combined with Lednikov's uncontested lead strongly favours horses with proven staying power and tactical speed over 1m4f.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lednikov Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Lednikov maintains his uncontested lead and kicks clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The veteran can use his tactical advantage to stretch the field when it matters, forcing the hold-up brigade into a traffic-laden sprint finish. His recent Southwell win proves he can convert front-running positions at this track and trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their challenges perfectly in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: Jack Andrea and Silkies Sib possess the best recent form and finishing kicks to overcome Lednikov's early advantage. Their proven ability at this distance on similar going makes them dangerous when produced with winning runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Lednikov goes too slow and creates a messy sprint finish from the home turn
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace becomes crawling, bunching the entire field and creating a cavalry charge where the best-handicapped horses can capitalise. Heartened's 15lb weight advantage becomes decisive in a slowly-run tactical battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Decides
scenarios.trigger: If the nine hold-up horses create a wall of traffic in the straight with no clear runs
scenarios.body: An outsider who gets a dream passage or switches to the outside early enough capitalises while the fancied runners are stuck behind faltering horses. Positioning luck trumps form in a rough passage.

watchPoints.text: Lednikov must be monitored for any early pressure as he's the only natural front runner and controls the race tempo completely
Jack Andrea's price movements and market confidence given his strong recent form and optimal racing weight of 130lbs
The break and early positioning of the nine hold-up horses as traffic problems will be inevitable in the straight
Weather conditions at Southwell as any track changes could significantly impact the form horses who are proven on standard going
Headgear changes on Silkies Sib (retained visor) and Late Claim (tongue-tie) suggesting connections expect improved performances
